name: o42599

name.description: A unique identifier (within the form) for the field. This value is not shown to the user and should NOT change once set.

maps_to.description: The name of the schema field the answer will map to. By default this will go to the "cf" field which is a "dynamic-field" list containing all answers filled out on the form (ref "gdbots:forms:mixin:send-submission").

label.description: The main text for the question/field.

description.description: A short description to better explain this field.

link_text.description: The text that will replace the token "{link}" within the label or description.

link_url.description: The URL to use for the replaced token "{link}" within the label or description.

description:
The field identified as **subscribe_newsletter** maps to the generic answer list **cf**. It is a required entry with a low privacy‑impact classification. The prompt presented to users reads: “Would you like to receive our newsletter?” and a short description follows: “Choose whether you want to receive promotional emails and updates.” Users can click the **privacy policy** (https://example.com/privacy) for more information. The input box shows the placeholder text “Select yes or no”.

The response options are labelled “Yes, sign me up!” for an affirmative answer and “No, thanks” for a negative answer.
